summary: The Guidance Clarity Act of 2025 requires every federal agency to display a standard statement on the first page of any new guidance document stating that the contents lack the force of law and bind neither the public nor the agency, with OMB required to issue implementing guidance within 90 days.

The bill addresses only the legal status of agency guidance and contains no provisions related to tax rates, tax collection, or tax policy.
